Validate referral_id from the landing UR: Validate referral_id from the landing URL with the referral API. Store the latest eligible referral for this campaign and offer in your server session, then save it with the order or business record before checkout.

Subscribe your merchant-owned adapter to: Subscribe your merchant-owned adapter to orders/paid. Verify the raw-body HMAC signature, expected shop and topic, and the paid state before trusting the delivery.
Map the stored referral, stable order ID: Map the stored referral, stable order ID, paid timestamp and agreed net amount to the DM Hub event. Send from your adapter; do not forward Shopify’s webhook payload directly. Submission forms need their own accepted-submission backend.
Preserve the validated referral in the W: Preserve the validated referral in the WooCommerce session and copy it to order metadata before payment. Use WooCommerce order APIs so the integration supports HPOS.
Connect your server-side payment-complet: Connect your server-side payment-complete handler, or authenticate a webhook in your adapter and check the order’s paid state. An order-updated notification alone is not payment confirmation.
Persist and queue the mapped DM Hub even: Persist and queue the mapped DM Hub event. Test classic checkout, Checkout Blocks, express checkout and asynchronous gateways separately.
